jobs.occupation: Senior Cost Estimator, EMEA Infrastructure Development - (m/w/d) (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

The EMEA Infrastructure Development team is seeking a Senior Cost Estimator to serve as the subject matter expert in construction cost estimating across Tesla's EMEA portfolio, including Service Centers, Retail Stores, Delivery Hubs, and Non-SSD sites (R&D, Training, Offices, etc.) You will drive the transition from decentralized regional estimating to a centralized EMEA-wide approach — defining the methodology, standards, templates, and governance for how projects are evaluated. You will deliver independent, reliable construction cost estimates at every project stage, giving project teams, designers, procurement, and leadership a trusted reference for go/no-go decisions.

What You’ll Do

- Develop cost estimates from Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) through detailed CapEx budgets, with accuracy appropriate to each project stage (AACE estimate classes as reference framework)
- Produce high-level estimates based on historic data to support go/no-go decisions against key cost metrics
- Analyze plans, Due diligence reports and interpret designs; perform dimensional quantity take-offs; identify scope implied but not explicitly shown in design documents
- Develop and manage a Basis of Estimate for each project — scope, execution strategy, precision level, assumptions, exclusions, risks, and critical information
- Lead value engineering at early design stages, providing cost-driven feedback and recommendations to designers
- Visit project sites as required to validate scope, site conditions, and constraints in support of estimation — working from assumptions and scope definition provided by the Project Manager, Real Estate team and design team
- Support the Procurement and PMs with contractor pricing validation and bid leveling to ensure we are receiving good value for spends
- Contribute to continuous improvement of estimating processes
- Maintain and update the cost database, ensuring pricing reflects current market conditions, inflation, transport costs, and regional differentiation
- Deliver accurate, independently validated estimates to support ATP and go/no-go decisions; review outputs against historic pricing and regional benchmarks
- Provide expert input to Procurement on sourcing and pricing for atypical works or high cost-variance items

What You’ll Bring

- Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, or related field — or equivalent professional experience
- 5+ years as a senior specialist or SME in project cost estimating, preferably in retail, commercial, industrial, or multi-site infrastructure rollout environments
- Practical knowledge of construction means and methods across civil, structural, architectural, MEP disciplines with the ability to translate technical knowledge into accurate, defensible cost advice
- Solid understanding of CapEx cost estimating from ROM through detailed CapEx budgeting; proven experience with quantity take-offs and design document interpretation
- Experience maintaining or developing pricing databases or cost libraries at a portfolio or multi-country level
- Ability of identifying main risks especially during ROM which could significantly impact the costs in a later stage
- Analytical, detail-oriented, and self-motivated; proactive communicator in a fast-paced, multicultural environment
- Experience building, leading, or transitioning to a centralized estimating function — methodology, SOPs, and standardization frameworks
- Proven track record as the go-to cost expert for project teams, designers, and leadership; authoritative cost advice with confidence, independence, and sound professional judgement
- Availability to travel across EMEA as required (up to 50%)
- English required; additional European language skills a strong plus

jobs.occupation: PhD Candidate in Functional Genomics and Pancreatic Cancer Research; part time 65%  (m/w/d) (Forschungsreferent/in)
jobs.description:
Scope of duties

· Work on the project “Global mapping of drug synergy landscapes using massively parallel Cas13d genetic interaction screening” within the German Cancer Aid-funded DEFEAT-PDAC consortium
· Investigate therapeutically relevant genetic dependencies and drug combinations in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
· Perform and analyze high-throughput genetic interaction screens, particularly using Cas13d-based screening approaches
· Plan and conduct molecular and cell biological experiments to validate identified targets and drug synergies
· Investigate rational combination therapies, including combinations with RAS/KRAS inhibitors
· Work with pancreatic cancer cell lines and additional preclinical model systems
· Apply modern methods in cell biology, molecular biology, functional genomics and proteomics
· Quantitatively analyze, interpret and document experimental data
· Collaborate closely with research groups and technology platforms within the DEFEAT-PDAC network
· Present research findings at project meetings and scientific conferences and contribute to scientific publications

Our requirements

· A successfully completed university degree, preferably a Master’s degree or equivalent, in biology, biochemistry, molecular medicine, biotechnology or a related life-science discipline
· Strong interest in cancer biology, functional genomics, mechanisms of therapy resistance and translational cancer research
· Practical experience in cell and molecular biology, for example mammalian cell culture, transfection, RNA and protein analysis, immunoblotting or microscopy
· Previous experience with CRISPR-based technologies, genetic screens, proteomics, next-generation sequencing or bioinformatic data analysis is an advantage, but not mandatory
· Motivation to learn new experimental technologies and quantitative analysis methods
· A careful, structured and independent approach to scientific work
· Scientific curiosity, high motivation and enthusiasm for experimental research
· Strong communication and teamwork skills and an interest in working in an interdisciplinary and international research environment
· Very good written and spoken English
· German language skills are not required

Our offer

· An innovative and challenging PhD project within the DEFEAT-PDAC consortium, a national and internationally connected research network funded by German Cancer Aid

· An international and interdisciplinary research environment at the interface of cancer biology, functional genomics, proteomics and clinical translation
· State-of-the-art laboratories and access to advanced screening, proteomics, sequencing and data-analysis platforms
· Close collaboration with basic scientists, bioinformaticians and clinician scientists
· Structured scientific supervision and support for your professional and personal development
· Opportunities to participate in national and international conferences, workshops and training programmes
· A collaborative, supportive and inspiring working environment that encourages scientific independence and the development of your own ideas
· Employment according to the German public-sector collective agreement, including annual leave and additional benefits in accordance with the applicable regulations
· The position is initially funded for three years. Subject to a positive scientific re-evaluation, an extension for up to two additional years is possible
· The position is based at the LMU University Hospital, Campus Großhadern, in Munich
· The remuneration is based on the Collective Agreement for the Public Service of the Federal States (TV-Ärzte) including all allowances customary in the public service.

jobs.occupation: Technology Transfer & Partnership Manager – Applied Geodata & Research Solutions (Full-Time / m/f/d) (Master of Business Administration)

Project Iris is an applied research initiative dedicated to automated spatial data analysis, land registry intelligence, sustainable infrastructure mapping, and open-source resilience modeling. 

To ensure long-term independence and funding for non-profit research, Project Iris works with an established commercial transfer network (including RE-Managers GmbH). Through this framework, proprietary data algorithms, geospatial scoring models, and automation tools are licensed and deployed across real-world commercial sectors (e.g., real estate, institutional investments, infrastructure providers, and SME enterprise solutions).

- Professional Competencies: 
- Strong interest in technology, spatial data, AI platforms, or digital business models. 
- Experience with or quick adoption of digital outreach tools, CRM systems (e.g., Odoo), and structured email communication.

- Mindset: Proactive, structured, and comfortable working at the intersection of non-profit research and commercial markets. 
- Eligibility: Open to local and international applicants currently in Germany (e.g., Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card, Job-Seeker Visa, EU Work Permit).

E-Mail: jobs@iris-institut.de

jobs.occupation: Trainee / Specialist – Data Mining & Web Scraping Automation (m/f/d) (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
Organization: IRIS – Institut für raumbezogene Infrastruktur und Raumforschung (gGmbH) 

Location: Germany (On-site / Hybrid with Relocation & Housing Support) 

Target Program: Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) / Master Trainees / International Talents 

Working Language: English (No initial German language skills required) 

About the Research Institute: 

The IRIS Institute (gGmbH) conducts applied research into spatial data systems, automated data extraction, and infrastructure transformation. We build scalable data pipelines to turn fragmented public records into structured spatial insights. 

What We Offer: 

We fully sponsor and support your relocation journey to Germany via the Opportunity Card framework, managing visa formalities, degree assessments, and onboarding logistics. You will benefit from organized accommodation, living allowances during training, sponsored German language classes, and hands-on exposure to production-grade data mining environments. 

Your Role & Key Tasks: 

You will design, develop, and maintain autonomous scraping routines and extraction agents for public registers, corporate filings, and official announcements. You will parse complex unstructured document formats—such as HTML, PDF, JSON, and XML—into clean, relational data structures, while monitoring data feeds and integrating incoming datasets into our core spatial repositories. 

Candidate Profile & Qualifications: 

Applicants should hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related technical subject. You should possess solid foundations or a strong motivation to develop your skills in Python (using libraries such as Scrapy, BeautifulSoup, Selenium, or Playwright), text parsing, regex, and structured data modelling. Fluent English is required. 

How to Apply: 

Please submit your CV and a brief cover letter in English. We look forward to reviewing your application! jobs@iris-institut.info (https://mailto:jobs@iris-institut.info)

jobs.occupation: Trainee / Specialist – Geospatial Data Engineering & Spatial Pipelines (m/f/d) (Geoinformatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Organization: IRIS – Institut für raumbezogene Infrastruktur und Raumforschung (gGmbH) 

Location: Germany (On-site / Hybrid with Relocation & Housing Support) 

Target Program: Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) / Master Trainees / International Talents 

Working Language: English (No initial German language skills required) 

About the Research Institute: 

The IRIS Institute (gGmbH) is a non-profit, applied research institute dedicated to developing cutting-edge spatial resilience data models and open-data architectures for the energy transition, critical infrastructure, and sustainable regional planning. 

What We Offer: 

We provide comprehensive administrative support for international candidates, including full assistance with the German Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte), degree recognition, and visa procedures. You will receive structured onboarding, local accommodation support, coverage of basic living expenses during training, on-site sponsored German language courses, and access to a modern data engineering tech stack centered on Python, PostGIS, Docker, and GIS platforms. 

Your Role & Key Tasks: 

In this role, you will build and maintain automated Python-based spatial data pipelines connecting to WFS services, REST APIs, and public open-data platforms. You will implement spatial overlay and inference models for energy grid matching and land-use analysis, while validating, structuring, and transforming vector geometries into our central PostgreSQL and PostGIS databases. 

Candidate Profile & Qualifications: 

We welcome applicants with a completed university degree in Geoinformatics, Computer Science, Data Science, Environmental Engineering, or a related technical discipline. You should bring practical experience or a strong learning interest in Python (GeoPandas, Shapely), SQL databases (PostgreSQL/PostGIS), spatial reference systems, and automated data ingestion workflows. High motivation and fluent English skills are required. 

How to Apply: 

Please submit your CV along with a short cover letter in English. We look forward to welcoming you to the IRIS team! jobs@iris-institut.info (https://mailto:jobs@iris-institut.info)
